title: Define proposed Mock-only website workflow contract
prohibited_actions: No HTTP request, website provider call, ObserverOS API, database, credential, upload, media, deployment, chat, or booking write
No person, customer, message, appointment, payment, traffic, Daily Roast, raw-source, or confirmation fixture
No mapping to existing ObserverOS BOOKING lifecycle, business decision, AI result, permission decision, or authoritative state
acceptance: Contract defines PROPOSED/MOCK-ONLY external-request and ObserverOS confirmation envelope
Only an opaque future OS confirmation reference can establish an authoritative request; every other state is non-authoritative
Contract explicitly rejects reuse of BOOKING for website reservations and preserves null data for unconfirmed/denied/error/pending states
Verification proves no network primitive, no sensitive fixture, and no authority claim
Typecheck, production build, control-plane validation, GitHub audit, and receipt pass
